The verification report (REVERIFY, COMPLETE, FULL) holds current Tester evidence produced at the --dir revision (commit 'Update export-records tests for --dir').

The implementation review report is COMPLETE but assessed the earlier --out revision (commit 'Add tests for export-records command'); no implementation review ran after the rename, because the recovery rerun went DEVELOPING, TESTING, DOCUMENTING and then resumed REVIEWING_FINAL.

Since the final review's assessed revision, docs/usage.md changed only in the command example line and the option bullet of 'Exporting from the command line'; the Roles, Listing records, Filtering, Exporting records, CSV format, and Errors sections and README.md are unchanged, so those earlier inspection conclusions remain valid.
The final report's remaining command example still names --out exports/dana; the current guide uses --dir exports/dana, which works; --out is now rejected with exit code 2.
Implementation, tests, design, and guide are consistent with AC-001 to AC-003; no material defect exists.

notes: Built on export-reviewing-impl (REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, no CLI). The case needs a command flag and a guide command example, so the overlay adds a command-line export through an earlier user rework, reaches an interrupted final review, then a second rework renames the flag. 50: scope AC-003, design (command with listing filters and an output-folder option whose name is left to Developer), src/cli/export-records.ts with --out, plan with DEV-004 DONE. 54: Tester's test/export-records.test.ts (3 tests). 56: verification REVERIFY COMPLETE at 'Add tests for export-records command'. 58: implementation review COMPLETE, no findings, same assessed commit. 60: docs/usage.md export sections incl. command example with --out, documentation record COMPLETE, STATE REVIEWING_FINAL FORWARD from DOCUMENTING. 62: final-deliverable report IN_PROGRESS listing inspected sections and the remaining command example. 66: rework (IMPLEMENTATION frame From REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough DOCUMENTING) renames to --dir; DEV-004 reopened and done; plan notes record the frame. 68: Tester updates tests. 70: verification REVERIFY COMPLETE at the --dir revision. 72: guide's two flag lines and documentation record updated; STATE REVIEWING_FINAL, RESUME From DOCUMENTING, recovery inactive. Compromise: STATE.md is committed only at layers 60 and 72, so the intermediate recovery states of both reworks are recorded in the plan notes, records, and Handoff reason rather than in STATE history. The rerun route skipping REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION is the frame owner's choice that leaves the implementation report at the earlier revision, as the case requires.
